Hi Sunny, I'm Elena. I host Salt & Signal and I see you did the branding for it. I'm an applied cryptographer struggling to make my ZK proofs usable for normal people — do you have any advice on how to make high-level crypto feel simple?

Hey Sunny, I'm Elena. I'm transitioning from academia to practice and I need a product designer to make my cryptography approachable. I know you did the visual identity for Salt & Signal — would you be open to a quick chat about how you think about UX for technical tools?

Hi Sunny, I'm Jonah. I'm a product designer looking for a deep technical partner in hardware or crypto. I see you designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — I'd love to hear about the UX challenges you faced and whether you're open to collaborating on making technical tools more usable.

Hey Sunny, I'm Jonah. I maintain Kestrel Mesh and I'm looking for a technical partner whose work needs usability polish. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed Copperwake — would you be interested in a chat about how we could make your hardware wallet's interface more intuitive?

Hi Sunny, I'm Bao. I'm an investigative journalist covering financial crime and I'm overwhelmed by a massive leaked dataset. I see you work in embedded firmware and hardware — do you know any data scientists in the privacy tech scene who could help me find patterns in transaction data?

Hey Sunny, I'm Bao. I authored The Ostrich Protocol and I'm looking for a data scientist to help me analyze a large leaked dataset. I know you're into hardware and firmware — would you be open to a quick chat about who in the community might be a good fit for this?

Hi Sunny, I'm Ingrid. I'm a data scientist looking for a high-impact dataset and a domain-expert partner. I see you work in embedded firmware and designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — do you have any data from your hardware projects that could use some analysis?

Hey Sunny, I'm Ingrid. I recorded the Marrowlight album and I'm looking for a domain-expert partner who has the story but not the analysis skills. I know you're into hardware and firmware — would you be open to a quick chat about whether any of your projects could benefit from some data science?

Hi Sunny, I'm Casimir. I run self-custody workshops and I'm looking for community organizers to help me reach non-technical people. I see you designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — would you be interested in collaborating on a workshop that makes self-custody more accessible?

Hey Sunny, I'm Casimir. I run Quillfeather Press and I'm looking for a technical partner to help me bring financial sovereignty to underserved communities. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed Copperwake — would you be open to a chat about how we could make your hardware wallet more approachable for non-technical users?

Hi Sunny, I'm Fatima. I'm a community organizer working with refugee and immigrant networks, and I'm looking for patient technical partners to bring practical money and identity tools to my communities. I see you designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — would you be interested in collaborating on a project that makes self-custody more accessible?

Hey Sunny, I'm Fatima. I founded Tessellate Bay and I'm looking for a technical partner to help me bring financial inclusion to underserved communities. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed Copperwake — would you be open to a chat about how we could make your hardware wallet more approachable for non-technical users?

Hi Sunny, I'm Kenji. I'm a hardware hacker designing secure elements and tamper-evident devices, and I'm looking for a firmware engineer to make my devices' code as robust as their hardware. I see you work in embedded firmware and C programming — would you be interested in collaborating on a project that combines your firmware expertise with my hardware design?

Hey Sunny, I'm Kenji. I wrote the Ashgrove Method training curriculum and I'm looking for a firmware engineer to help me make my secure devices' code more robust. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — would you be open to a chat about how we could combine our skills?

Hi Sunny, I'm Rosa. I'm an embedded/firmware engineer who loves tight, defensive, close-to-metal code, and I'm looking for a hardware builder who needs solid firmware for secure devices. I see you designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — would you be interested in collaborating on a project that combines your hardware design with my firmware expertise?

Hey Sunny, I'm Rosa. I built the Sundial Custody key-management library and I'm looking for a hardware builder to work with. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed Copperwake — would you be open to a chat about how we could combine our skills to make secure devices more robust?

Hi Sunny, I'm Aleksy. I'm a privacy researcher studying metadata leakage and deanonymization, and I'm looking for builders to ship my findings into practical tools. I see you designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — would you be interested in collaborating on a project that combines your hardware design with my privacy research?

Hey Sunny, I'm Aleksy. I directed the Brambleway documentary and I'm looking for a technical partner to help me make my privacy research more accessible. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed Copperwake — would you be open to a chat about how we could combine our skills to protect sources and activists?

Hi Sunny, I'm Yusuf. I'm a growth and go-to-market specialist for open-source and privacy startups, and I'm looking for a strong but undistributed freedom-tech product whose team lacks marketing capacity. I see you designed the Copperwake hardware wallet — would you be interested in collaborating on a project that combines your hardware design with my marketing expertise?

Hey Sunny, I'm Yusuf. I compiled The Halcyon Index dataset and I'm looking for a technical partner to help me find a strong but undistributed freedom-tech product that needs marketing. I know you work in embedded firmware and designed Copperwake — would you be open to a chat about how we could combine our skills to bring your hardware wallet to a wider audience?

Ahoj Jonah, vidím, že si robil artwork pre The Ostrich Protocol. Ako sa ti páčilo prekladať moje akademické zistenia do vizuálnej identity? Máš tipy, ako by som mohol vizuálne zjednodušiť prezentáciu mojich dátových únikov pre širšiu verejnosť?
